---
title: "MMR Vaccination Coverage"
output: html_document
params:
  boundary: NULL
  school_data: NULL
  childcare_data: NULL
  selected_district: NULL
  selected_county: NULL
  point_type: NULL
  selected_location: NULL
  district_data: NULL
  county_data: NULL
  grade_data: NULL
  selected_school_id: NULL
  map_view: NULL
  coverage_bands: NULL
  notes: NULL
  features: NULL
  settings: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
features <- if (is.null(params$features)) all_features() else params$features
bands <- coverage_bands(params$coverage_bands)
notes <- if (is.null(params$notes)) default_settings()$notes else params$notes
selected <- select_facility(params$selected_school_id, params$school_data, params$childcare_data)
if (is.null(selected)) selected <- select_facility(params$selected_location, params$school_data, params$childcare_data)
is_school <- !is.null(selected) && selected$type == "school"
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(selected)) {
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$h2(selected$name),
    htmltools::tags$p(paste0(if (is_school) "School ID: " else "Child Care ID: ", selected$id))
  )
}
```

```{r}
if (features$facility_overview && !is.null(selected)) {
  build_facility_overview_table(paste0(selected$type, ":", selected$id),
    params$school_data, params$childcare_data, params$county_data, params$district_data)
}
```

```{r}
if (features$coverage_map) coverage_map_title(params$county_data)
```

```{r}
if (features$coverage_map) {
  district_mode <- isTRUE(params$boundary == "district") &&
    !is.null(params$district_data) && nrow(params$district_data) > 0
  build_coverage_map(if (district_mode) params$district_data else params$county_data,
    boundary = if (district_mode) "district" else "county", bands = bands, map_view = params$map_view,
    settings = params$settings)
}
```

```{r}
if (features$grade_table && is_school) {
  grade_level_table(grade_data = params$grade_data, school_id = selected$id)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
if (features$grade_plot && is_school) {
  grade_level_plot(grade_data = params$grade_data, school_id = selected$id,
    bands = bands, settings = params$settings)
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
if (!is.null(privacy_footnote_html(notes))) cat(privacy_footnote_html(notes))
```
